pass_rule: Common gaming routes tested: partnership inflation, publication quantity without relevance, duplicated evidence, marketing-only claims and superficial digital presence.
interpretation_rule: Synthetic attack success demonstrates that known gaming patterns are detected or blocked. G10 still requires real adversarial/red-team review against the frozen methodology and scoring workflow.
blockers_to_start: No frozen Pilot 20 scoring workflow exists for adversarial testing.
No real red-team exercise has tested dossier/source manipulation routes.
No human review has assessed false-positive risk in anti-gaming flags.
No operational escalation procedure has been exercised on a real or controlled institution dossier.
human_gate: Anti-gaming flags may trigger evidence review; they may not infer intent, blacklist an institution, or impose an institution-wide penalty without authorised human review.
